title: Model Serving and Management
summary: This module orchestrates the entire lifecycle of AI models, from handling API requests for inference and management to scheduling model loading, managing metadata, and facilitating model creation and conversion.

nodes.label: API Endpoints
nodes.title: API Endpoints
nodes.description: Defines and manages all HTTP API endpoints for interacting with the model serving and management system, routing requests to appropriate handlers.

nodes.label: Model Scheduling and Caching
nodes.title: Model Scheduling and Caching
nodes.description: Manages the loading, unloading, and caching of AI models to optimize resource utilization and response times, handling model lifecycle and memory.

nodes.label: Model Creation and Conversion
nodes.title: Model Creation and Conversion
nodes.description: Handles the creation of new models from various source files and manages quantization, template application, and format conversions.

nodes.label: Model Metadata and Prompting
nodes.title: Model Metadata and Prompting
nodes.description: Manages model-related metadata, including templates, system prompts, and capabilities, and handles prompt rendering for various models.

nodes.label: Low-Level Model Operations
nodes.title: Low-Level Model Operations
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for model creation, quantization, MLX runner management, and image generation at a lower level.

groups.label: Core Model Services
groups.title: Core Model Services
groups.description: These modules handle the fundamental aspects of model operation, including efficient scheduling, caching, and managing model configurations and prompting strategies.

groups.label: Model Lifecycle Management
groups.title: Model Lifecycle Management
groups.description: This module is responsible for the creation, conversion, and initial setup of models within the system, preparing them for serving.

groups.label: External Interfaces
groups.title: External Interfaces
groups.description: This module provides the public-facing API endpoints through which users and other services interact with the model serving system.

groups.label: Underlying Mechanisms
groups.title: Underlying Mechanisms
groups.description: This module contains the low-level implementations for model creation, quantization, and MLX-specific runtime optimizations that support the higher-level services.
